unsafe base.
Choice = Type (LeftCell Int | RightCell Int).
choose n = if n < 0 then choose (0 - n) else if n % 2 == 0 then LeftCell n else RightCell (n + 1).
fold n acc = if n <= 0 then acc else case choose n of LeftCell x -> fold (n - 1) (acc + x) | RightCell x -> fold (n - 1) (acc - x).
main = print (fold 1000 0).

Choice = Type (LeftCell Int | RightCell Int).
choose n = if n < 0 then choose (0 - n) else if n % 2 == 0 then (True,n) else (False,n + 1).
fold n acc = if n <= 0 then acc else case choose n of (side,x) -> if side then fold (n - 1) (acc + x) else fold (n - 1) (acc - x).
main = print (fold 1000 0).
